description: Calibrated from microbenchmarks on this machine. ALU/libm weights (pow_default, transcendental) are measured. Memory/stencil weights retain the guestimates: a single-node streaming loop cannot reproduce the distributed-memory ghost-exchange costs those weights encode; see measurements.decisions. Previously unweighted functions (tan/sinh/cosh/tanh/erf) now carry measured weights. Positive weights are scaled so the smallest is 100; transcendental_default stays 0. Ratios in measurements are unchanged.

architecture.cpu: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX PRO 370 w/ Radeon 890M

decisions.pow_integer_floor: retained 200: integer-power streaming runs are bandwidth-bound (~1x add) and cannot resolve ALU scaling; log2 formula kept.
decisions.transcendental: measured per-function ratios; sqrt run varied 0.87x/1.91x across probes (kept 200, conservative); cbrt 10x/12x across probes (kept 1200).
decisions.symbol_grid: retained 1000: measured grid load is ~0.4x add single-node, but the weight guides global-vs-local promotion where distributed costs dominate.
decisions.stencil: retained 1000/4000/10000: measured center/x/y/z differ by <15% single-node; the guestimates encode ghost-exchange costs this loop cannot reproduce.
decisions.div: streaming div is bandwidth-bound (1.07x); register-isolated div is 3.0x add. div reaches the model via Pow[x**-1] with floor 200; left as is.
